title: Number Systems
subtitle: Introduction to Rational and Irrational Numbers
subject: Mathematics
author: AI Assistant
learning_outcomes: Identify and classify rational and irrational numbers.
Represent irrational numbers on the number line.
Understand the decimal expansion of real numbers.
Apply laws of exponents for real numbers.

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the concepts of rational and irrational numbers and perform operations involving real numbers.
common_misconceptions: Assuming all square roots are irrational numbers (e.g., sqrt(4)).
Confusing terminating and non-terminating decimals with rational/irrational categorization.
Making mistakes in rationalizing denominators with binomial expressions.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Remember that if a decimal terminates or repeats, it's a rational number. If it goes on forever without repeating, it's irrational.
